$comment: Where this site’s committed data came from. Written when the folder was first committed; `bun run fetch hamburg` and `bun run bake hamburg` regenerate everything from the sources named here (raw downloads live in data/_raw/hh/, never committed).
retrieved: 2026-09-24 (provider products); Wikidata and the re-bake of the bridge steps 2026-09-27

provider.name: Landesbetrieb Geoinformation und Vermessung Hamburg (LGV)
provider.credit: Freie und Hansestadt Hamburg, Landesbetrieb Geoinformation und Vermessung (LGV), dl-de/by-2-0

committed.data/hamburg/dgm/: DGM1 per tile, clipped to the 2 km grid and written compact (DEFLATE, float predictor, centimetres) by `bun run fetch`
committed.data/hamburg/cityjson/: LoD2 per tile, converted from the provider’s CityGML by pipeline/bake/citygml.py
committed.data/hamburg/dlm/: the derived per-tile artifacts of `bun run bake` (class raster, canopy, vegetation, OSM layers, …)
committed.data/hamburg/dop/: per-tile values derived from the orthophoto (roof colours)

openstreetmap.licence: Open Database License (ODbL); credit: © OpenStreetMap contributors
openstreetmap.usedFor: land cover (no open Basis-DLM) and every OSM layer

wikidata.usedFor: bridge names and types, cached per tile under data/_raw/hh/wikidata/

traffic.title: Verkehrsmengen 2019 (DTV) der Hauptverkehrsstraßen, Behörde für Verkehr und Mobilitätswende
traffic.licence: dl-de/by-2-0; credit: Freie und Hansestadt Hamburg, Behörde für Verkehr und Mobilitätswende
traffic.coverage: the main roads (HVS), both directions together, rounded to the thousand, with the heavy-goods share in %; split evenly between the directions (sp 1)

sections.$comment: per tile bbox incl. the 50 m margin, before the clip
